status: Amended 2026-09-25 under the owner review (WP2). Every property now states its antecedent, allowed outputs, deadline origin, exceptions, observables, inconclusive rule, worked examples and its observer. A deadline whose residual bound is unknown is labelled not yet evaluable instead of being filled with a number, and the mode/action part stays evaluable.
model_identity_required: Every query is evaluated only against a model whose hash matches models/px4-study-a/source-manifest.json; a witness carries both hashes.

clock.semantics: vehicle clock (uORB hrt / MAVLink time_boot_ms), never host wall clock

shared_exclusions.rule: A hazard whose exception bit is set for the active user-intended mode is not active for any property.
A hazard configured to action None is not a monitor breach; the failsafe is disabled by configuration.
shared_exclusions.source: failsafe.cpp L47-51, L515; NAV_DLL_ACT=0 is the vendor default [B10]

shared_exclusions.rule: The documented UX downgrades to Warn (already in AUTO_LAND, AUTO_RTL or AUTO_PRECLAND when RTL/Land would be selected) are not violations.
A lower action produced by the mode-requirement fallback chain is not a priority violation.
User takeover (stick request or mode switch while an action allows it) legitimately reduces the selected action to Warn.

properties.name: no response to an eligible monitored condition
properties.natural_language: A failsafe flag stays true past the point where the framework must have acted, while the selected action is still None or Warn.
properties.delayable_actions_note: The Hold-first delay applies only when COM_FAIL_ACT_T > 0.1 s and the action is not Disarm, Terminate or Hold; it is cleared when a failsafe is already active, when Hold cannot run, or on takeover.
source: framework.cpp L351-362 (delay armed only when COM_FAIL_ACT_T > 0.1)
properties.witness_format: event schedule + expected (flag, t_rise) and (selected_action, t) pairs over the horizon
properties.known_limitations: False positive if a flag rises during a mode transition in which the framework has not yet run an update cycle; treat a violation with margin < 1 update period as inconclusive.
properties.requirement_source: study-defined obligation; NOT copied from the implementation
properties.antecedent: a monitored condition is raised, its configured action is not None or Warn, and no exclusion applies
allowed_outputs: any action of higher precedence for a concurrently active condition
properties.deadline_origin: the detected flag's rise. The detection timeout (COM_DL_LOSS_T and friends) is spent BEFORE the flag rises, so adding it again after the flag would double-count it.
properties.deadline: configured Hold delay drawn from the shared pot, PLUS an update/transport residual that this apparatus cannot bound
properties.deadline_note: The source-controlled part is derivable. The residual is not: the injection instant has no defensible upper bound in this rig (D24), so no total is frozen. The mode and action parts of U1 stay evaluable and are checked.
properties.persistence: the obligation stands while the condition is raised and the action remains configured
exceptions: a None/Warn configuration carries no manoeuvre obligation; warning-only battery behaviour is not a missing response
observables: failsafe_flags time series with recording coverage
properties.inconclusive_rule: unbounded or straddling timing, or a required channel absent per conversion.failsafe_flag_channels
properties.example_satisfying: datalink lost, NAV_DLL_ACT=2, AUTO_RTL entered after the Hold delay
properties.example_violating: datalink lost, NAV_DLL_ACT=2, no recovery mode for the whole horizon with the flag held true
properties.example_inconclusive: the flag rose but the log ends before the deadline could pass
properties.example_not_triggered: NAV_DLL_ACT=0, so the antecedent never holds (X2)
properties.example_disabled_action: GF_ACTION=0 with a geofence breach: no obligation, and a fired property would be a defect in the property
properties.antecedent_reachability_query: is there a run in which the antecedent holds at all
properties.model_boundary: the Python selector is a restricted transcription; mode-eligibility fallback is an input, not modelled
properties.executability: offline fixture and SITL now; native oracle once D14's job runs; checker pending D8

properties.name: arbitration below the highest eligible action
properties.natural_language: Two or more hazards are active and the engaged action sits lower in the pinned precedence order than the action configured for the highest-precedence active hazard.
source: framework.h L52-70 ('Actions further down take precedence')
framework.cpp L462-481 (selection is the maximum over active actions)
required_channels: the configured action map for the run
properties.witness_format: two hazard rise times + the engaged action at the evaluation instant
properties.known_limitations: Requires at least two simultaneously injectable hazards; the single-event validation matrix does not exercise this property, so predictions on pairs are hypotheses until replayed (see decisions-2026-09-19.md D9).
properties.requirement_source: implementation-derived conformance rule; the precedence order is PX4's own
properties.antecedent: two or more conditions are active with different configured actions
allowed_outputs: the maximum configured action over the active set
Hold while a legitimate shared delay is still running
properties.deadline_origin: the later of the two flag rises
properties.deadline: the shared delay pot's remaining value, not COM_FAIL_ACT_T and not a per-hazard sum
properties.persistence: evaluated only after a COMPLETED framework update, never inside one
exceptions: a pending Hold-first delay is legal and is not an arbitration failure; it becomes one only once the delay has elapsed
properties.inconclusive_rule: the selected action is not on any recorded channel in this apparatus, so U2 is currently unobservable in SITL
properties.example_satisfying: RTL and Land active, Land committed after the delay
properties.example_violating: RTL and Land active, RTL committed after the delay has elapsed
properties.example_inconclusive: both active, delay still running, evaluated mid-delay
properties.example_disabled_action: one of the two configured to None: the set has one eligible member and U2 does not apply
properties.antecedent_reachability_query: can two configured conditions be active simultaneously in the supported domain
properties.observer: model fixture and native oracle only; query Q3
properties.model_boundary: distinguishes configured, eligible, pending, selected and committed; only selected and committed are checked
properties.executability: offline fixture and native oracle; NOT executable in SITL while the selector is unobserved

properties.name: oscillation between recovery functions
properties.natural_language: The selected action leaves and re-enters a recovery function more than once within the window while the hazard has not cleared.
properties.window_basis: COM_DL_LOSS_T default 10 s [B10]; windowed-oracle form follows S2's 7 s route-deviation oracle [B11] — 2026-09-24: this is a chosen study parameter. COM_DL_LOSS_T's default motivates the magnitude; it does not justify 10 s as the oscillation window, and no source does.
source: framework.cpp L121-141 (updateStartDelay increases the delay slower than it reduces it, i.e. the code already treats oscillation as a hazard)
properties.witness_format: ordered list of (t, action) toggles with the hazard held true
properties.known_limitations: A flapping *input* (link up/down) legitimately produces action changes; the property requires the hazard flag to remain true throughout the window.
properties.requirement_source: study-defined; the source's own toggling protection motivates it but does not define the window
properties.antecedent: the selected action leaves and re-enters a recovery function while the condition stays raised
allowed_outputs: a monotone escalation such as Hold then RTL then Land
a single justified de-escalation on clear
properties.deadline_origin: the first departure from the recovery function
properties.deadline_note: Chosen, not derived. COM_DL_LOSS_T's default motivates the magnitude and no source justifies 10 s as an oscillation window. A paper using another window validates nothing here.
properties.persistence: the condition must remain raised throughout; a flapping input legitimately produces action changes
exceptions: input flap: the condition itself cleared and re-raised
observables: failsafe flag edges in both directions
properties.inconclusive_rule: either series incomplete, or the order of a clear and a re-raise undetermined
properties.example_satisfying: Hold then RTL, held to the horizon
properties.example_violating: RTL, Hold, RTL, Hold inside 10 s with the flag continuously true
properties.example_inconclusive: the flag series has a gap across the window
properties.example_disabled_action: action None: nothing to oscillate between
properties.antecedent_reachability_query: can a repeated clear and re-raise drive two action changes inside the window
properties.observer: model fixture; query Q4. U3 previously had NO query at all
properties.model_boundary: needs the shared delay pot, which the model now carries (WP3)
properties.executability: offline fixture now; SITL blocked on the selector channel

properties.name: no commitment to an allowed navigation response
properties.natural_language: Time from hazard onset to a registered terminal mode exceeds the configured bound.
properties.correction_note: NOT the sum of every configured delay. PX4 holds a single shared delay counter initialised from COM_FAIL_ACT_T, not one timer per hazard, so summing per-hazard delays over-estimates the bound and would hide real violations.
source: framework.cpp L48-51, L143-147 (both initialised from COM_FAIL_ACT_T)
properties.terminology: Always 'registered terminal mode'; the banned claim vocabulary in AGENTS.md and docs/claim-ledger.md applies to every statement about this result.
properties.witness_format: hazard rise time, expected terminal mode, and the horizon at which it was not reached
properties.known_limitations: Depends on the continuous manoeuvre-time estimate; if the interval abstraction is not conservative for a configuration, the property is inconclusive rather than violated.
properties.requirement_source: study-defined obligation, split from physical completion on 2026-09-25 (D17)
properties.antecedent: U1's antecedent holds and a response action has been selected
allowed_outputs: entry into, or continuation in, a navigation mode allowed for that action
properties.deadline_origin: the selected action, not the flag and not the injection
properties.deadline: the same unresolved residual as U1
properties.persistence: commitment must hold while the condition is raised
exceptions: already being in an allowed response mode satisfies the state obligation when its preconditions hold; a fresh transition is required only where the requirement calls for one
observables: the mode allowed for the selected action
properties.inconclusive_rule: window membership undetermined, or the allowed set depends on an unobserved precondition
properties.example_violating: RTL selected, the vehicle stays in OFFBOARD
properties.example_inconclusive: the transition falls inside the injection's unbounded interval
properties.example_not_triggered: no action was selected because the antecedent failed
properties.example_disabled_action: action None: no commitment is owed
properties.antecedent_reachability_query: is a selected action ever observed in this apparatus
properties.observer: harness/verify.py per-timeline expected sequence; query Q2
properties.model_boundary: physical completion is OUT. Landing, containment and descent need dynamics the discrete model does not represent. No speed-limit quotient is used as a deadline: distance over a maximum speed is the LEAST time a manoeuvre can take, so it is a lower bound, and using it as a deadline would fire on every run flying below full speed.
properties.executability: offline fixture and SITL for mode commitment; physical completion not evaluated anywhere
properties.deadline_note: Shares U1's unresolved residual. The source-controlled delay is derivable; the update and transport component is not bounded in this apparatus, so no total is frozen and the mode-commitment part is checked on its own.

not_properties: Containment (leaving the flight geography or contingency volume) is recorded in the trace but not decided by the checker at this stage; the model has no position dynamics. [B7]
Reconnection behaviour is observed-but-out-of-model until it has its own automaton, property and validation test.

verdict_vocabularies.why_two: A simulation pass and a symbolic proof are different claims and must never share a status field. The first is about one run; the second is about a model.

per_run_observation.satisfied: the required observation exists, is complete, and meets the obligation
per_run_observation.violated: the required observation exists, is complete, and contradicts the obligation
per_run_observation.inconclusive: the observation exists but its uncertainty does not decide the obligation
per_run_observation.unverified: the comparison could not be made: identity, validity, or a missing required channel
per_run_observation.not_applicable: the antecedent did not hold in this run
per_run_observation.must_carry: reason and component boundary (detector, selector, or mode entry)

study_or_checker_claim.no_violation_observed_in_tests: the registered suite ran and nothing violated
study_or_checker_claim.no_violation_within_checked_bounds: a bounded check completed inside stated limits
study_or_checker_claim.established_over_the_abstract_model: symbolic checking completed; initial states, assumptions and encoding reported
study_or_checker_claim.unknown: timeout, memory limit, unsupported semantics, unreachable antecedent, inadequate observation, or unjustified abstraction

verdict_vocabularies.reporting_rule: Missing recovery is a discrete failure when a valid, complete window establishes it. Missing or truncated observation is uncertainty. Neither disappears from the latency denominator. Detector, selector and mode-entry latencies are reported separately, and physical completion is reported as not evaluated.

query_map.why: Requirement ids and diagnostic queries are different things. Every in-scope obligation needs one or a declared gap.

Q1.status: specified; timing component not yet evaluable

Q2.status: specified and executable for mode entry

D1.status: diagnostic only, never a substitute for U1-U4

D2.status: diagnostic only; a property that never triggers is not a pass
